authorization.scope: Maintainer acceptance for this release, the exact official rc.2 host manifest/lock and the ten listed advisories only.

expiry: A product/host identity or manifest/lock change, new advisory or unreviewed report invalidates this decision. A clean scan remains clean; scanner and capture failures remain failures.
note: The two reviewed reports contain the same ten direct advisories with 75 and 78 affected package entries. This acceptance does not fix the vulnerabilities or cover root/runtime/Python findings.
